name: fast-fit-physical-transfer-v1
network: Independent zonal corridor bounds summed from retained cross-zone AC thermal ratings and native hourly controllable-link bounds. Model-derived limits, not verified commercial NTC/ATC. Original PTDF/intrazonal/island coupling removed in this candidate only.
transport_cost_scope: Predeclared notebook coefficient per aggregated corridor: marginal transport spread=kappa*flow_GW before saturation. An experimental economic assumption, not a calibrated tariff or numerical ridge.
bid_family: Smoothed inverse piecewise-linear six-node supply; original actual hourly available MW/source-cost anchors, zero economic renewable bids and fixed hydro inputs. No artificial scarcity/emergency supply.
monthly_parameters: 24 shared local-hour curves per technology/zone; six raw parameters. Exact implicit gradients of balance equations on identified directions, no backward ridge.
selection: Minimum full-February observed-price MAE; stop only after three consecutive nonimprovements at 1e-6 EUR/MWh. Continue exact Adam state after update3; no three-update budget.
scope: Full January fit/February validation, then frozen curves in original coupled physical LP. All48 zones/all1416 monthly hours retained. No annual fitted-validation or baseline claim.
numerical_recovery: Same direction-preserving Newton/coordinate equations; cold monthly initialization for neutral annual tests and cold retries for failed warm-start batches. No economic or tolerance change.
